# Wayfair Canada

> > Wayfair Canada is an online home furnishings retailer offering furniture, décor, outdoor products, and home essentials with daily deals and clearance sales.

Wayfair Canada operates as the Canadian division of the Wayfair e-commerce platform, featuring brands like Mercer41, Wrought Studio, Wade Logan, and Real Flame. The site specializes in home furnishings across multiple categories with a focus on Canadian customers, offering daily deals and clearance promotions on furniture and home décor items.
